system.description:
You target a creature you can see in range and attempt to switch its brains perception of light. The target creature must make an Intelligence Save. If this jutsu is cast on a creature who is not benefiting from Bright Light prior to this jutsu’s casting, this jutsu gains the Unaware Keyword for the duration. Creatures can remake their saving throws at the end of each of their turns ending its effect on a success.

Critical Success: Affected creature is able to resist this Jutsu's effect

Success: Affected creature gains a rank of Dazzled until the end of their next turn.

Failure: Affected creature treats Bright light as Dim light, and Dim light as total darkness for the purpose of perceiving things for the duration. Creatures who are physically in Bright light at the beginning of their turns takes 3d8 psychic damage for the duration.

Critical Failure: Same as failure but affected creatures treat Bright Light as total darkness for the duration and takes 5d8 psychic damage if they are physically in Bright light at the beginning of their turns.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the number of targets by +1.
